title: MLX local music providers: MusicGen variants and ChatMusician composition
summary: generate_music gained musicgen_audiogen (mono/stereo/melody variants with first-run weight auto-provisioning) and chatmusician_mlx (ABC composition rendered to WAV), plus a vocals/instrumental request split and a compose selection purpose.
hint_triggers: Local CLI music backends: media-generation.musicgen_audiogen (KYBERION_MUSAUDIOGEN_*, variant via model mapping, weights auto-fetched once from pre-converted HF repos into ~/.mlx-audiogen/models) and media-generation.chatmusician_mlx (KYBERION_CHATMUSICIAN_*, mlx-lm ABC output rendered via abc2midi -o and position-sensitive fluidsynth flags, SoundFont required). All local providers are instrumental-only; vocals:true fails closed with a SongGeneration-MLX future pointer. Purpose compose ranks composition ability via the composition trait. Integration pitfalls recorded in test-report: mlx-audiogen requires --weights-dir, huggingface-cli was renamed to hf, registry shared headers compare strictly including key order.
